typography.rationale: High legibility, strict business tone, excellent for numbers and dense Russian text.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-zinc-200. Dense grid borders for tables.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Strictly no soft drop shadows. Use border for separation. Floating menus get shadow-md.
visual_enhancers.radii: Max rounded-sm (2px to 4px) to keep a sharp, serious look.

component_name.table: Dense DataTable (Shadcn customized). px-2 py-1 padding. Sticky header. Hover row bg-zinc-50/50.
component_name.button: Flat, rounded-sm, primary color bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700. h-8 for dense actions.
component_name.input: h-8, rounded-sm, sharp focus ring-2 ring-blue-500.
component_name.badge: Subtle background (bg-zinc-100) with solid text. No glossy effects.

layouts.general: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Topbar (h-14) + Main Content Area.
layouts.spacing: Dense. Use p-4 for cards/containers, but p-1/p-2 for internal data elements.

motion.philosophy: Functional only. No parallax, no delayed entrances.
motion.transitions: Only hover and focus states (150ms). Use basic transition-colors.

accessibility.contrast: Strict WCAG AA. High contrast text.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all actionable elements (buttons, inputs, links).

media.3d_libraries: None. Project requires 'no unnecessary visual effects'.

login_background.description: Minimal abstract architecture, to be used as a subtle background for the login screen. It provides a strict, professional vibe.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design an internal CRM targeted for the Russian market. ALL TEXT, mock data, and labels must be in Russian.
Style: Strict business desktop. Enforce a light theme. Use zinc-50 as app background and white for cards/tables.
Density: This is a data-heavy application. Tables must be extremely dense (Compact Mode). Override Shadcn's default table padding to `px-2 py-1` or `h-8`.
Borders/Corners: Use flat aesthetics. Restrict border-radius to `rounded-sm`. Remove soft drop shadows and replace with 1px `border-zinc-200` lines.
Navigation: Implement a persistent left sidebar (Sidebar component) with navigation to: Главная, Организации, Импорт, Очередь, Шаблоны, Ответы, Дубли, Экспорт, Журнал, Настройки.
Pages required: Login, Dashboard, Organizations table, Import wizard (with step-by-step UI), Queue management, Templates editor, Settings.
Interactive Elements: Add `data-testid` to all inputs, buttons, and rows.
Icons: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide with small size (size=16) to maintain density.
Ensure 'Stop' (Остановить рассылку) is styled defensively (e.g., destructive variant with confirmation).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Maintain high contrast ratios for readability (APCA preferred over WCAG).
Hover states must always be explicitly defined.
Ensure focus states are highly visible for keyboard navigation.
Do not use transparent backgrounds over content; use solid colors or heavy blurs.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
